notes: After our recent podcast conversation, Matt Breitfelder, Partner and Global Head of Human Capital at Apollo, asked me if he could turn the tables and, in his words, interview the interviewer about interviewing. We did that and added a two-way conversation about public speaking. Our conversation covers my path to the podcast, preparation for interviews, components of what makes it work, and tips for asking good questions. We then turn to public speaking, focusing on the challenges and techniques for moderating panels and presenting in public. And of course, at the end, Matt asks me my closing questions. Please enjoy my distillation of lessons learned from having your ear for six years in this conversation guided by Matt Breitfelder. For full show notes, visit the episode webpage here .  Ted Seides – The Art of the Interview (EP.330) 
 
 Ted Seides – The Art of the Interview (EP.330) Jul 31, 2023

 After our recent podcast conversation, Matt Breitfelder, Partner
and Global Head of Human Capital at Apollo, asked me if he could
turn the tables and, in his words, interview the interviewer about
interviewing. We did that and added a two-way conversation about
public speaking.

Our conversation covers my path to the podcast, preparation for
interviews, components of what makes it work, and tips for asking
good questions. We then turn to public speaking, focusing on the
challenges and techniques for moderating panels and presenting in
public. And of course, at the end, Matt asks me my closing
questions.

Please enjoy my distillation of lessons learned from having your
ear for six years in this conversation guided by Matt
Breitfelder.

For full show notes, visit the episode webpage 
here .

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
